card.name: Time-unit words in durations
card.fires_on: Time-period words such as mes, semaine, fortnight, weeks and years (yrs) right after a number or 'un', and sometimes the end of words like selectman. Strongest on Spanish 'mes' after a quantity.

modes.label: Time unit after number
modes.description: A unit of time, often Spanish or French, follows a count or 'un' to give a span.
modes.example: Un<< mes>> después del evento climático hubo

modes.label: Partial time-unit words
modes.description: A time word is split so the marked piece sits inside it, such as week or fortnight, or the ending of a word like selectman.
